name: filesystem identity host evidence

on:
  pull_request:
    branches: ['main']
    paths:
    - 'package/module/fs-id/**'
    - '.github/workflows/fs-id.yml'
  push:
    branches: ['main']
    paths:
    - 'package/module/fs-id/**'
    - '.github/workflows/fs-id.yml'

concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  preferred-identity:
    name: preferred identity (${{ matrix.os }})
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        os:
        - ubuntu-latest
        - macos-latest
        - windows-latest
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    steps:
    - name: Checkout
      uses: actions/checkout@de0fac2e4500dabe0009e67214ff5f5447ce83dd
      with:
        fetch-depth: 1

    - name: Set up Node
      uses: actions/setup-node@a0853c24544627f65ddf259abe73b1d18a591444
      with:
        node-version: 26.5.0
        package-manager-cache: false

    - name: Resolve preferred identity
      run: node package/module/fs-id/src/host-evidence.ts

name: readonly semantic bridge host evidence

on:
  pull_request:
    branches: ['main']
    paths:
    - 'package/config/oxlint/**'
    - 'package/ownership-markers/foreign-borrowed/**'
    - 'package/oxlint-plugin/no-restricted-syntax/**'
    - 'package/oxlint-plugin/prefer-readonly-parameter-type/**'
    - 'package/oxlint-plugin/shared/**'
    - 'package/test-fixture/oxlint-no-restricted-syntax/**'
    - 'pnpm-lock.yaml'
    - '.github/workflows/readonly-semantic-bridge.yml'
  merge_group:
    branches: ['main']
  push:
    branches: ['main']
    paths:
    - 'package/config/oxlint/**'
    - 'package/ownership-markers/foreign-borrowed/**'
    - 'package/oxlint-plugin/no-restricted-syntax/**'
    - 'package/oxlint-plugin/prefer-readonly-parameter-type/**'
    - 'package/oxlint-plugin/shared/**'
    - 'package/test-fixture/oxlint-no-restricted-syntax/**'
    - 'pnpm-lock.yaml'
    - '.github/workflows/readonly-semantic-bridge.yml'

concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  semantic-bridge:
    name: semantic bridge (${{ matrix.os }})
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        os:
        - ubuntu-latest
        - macos-15
        - windows-latest
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    env:
      MISE_AUTO_INSTALL: 'false'
    steps:
    - name: Checkout
      uses: actions/checkout@de0fac2e4500dabe0009e67214ff5f5447ce83dd
      with:
        fetch-depth: 1

    - name: Set up mise without repository-wide tool installation
      uses: jdx/mise-action@c2a87611a18de5b3828c5652fe268e992400cb5c
      with:
        # Resolve "latest" through the GitHub releases API, published releases only,
        # one day old like pnpm's minimumReleaseAge. Without it the action installs
        # whatever mise.jdx.dev/VERSION names, which runs ahead of the GitHub release
        # (2025.8.19, 2026.9.3): doc/troubleshooting/mise-action-version-ahead-of-release.md
        minimum_release_age: 1d
        install: false

    - name: Install package tools
      run: mise install node pnpm

    - name: Install workspace dependencies
      run: mise exec node pnpm -- pnpm install --frozen-lockfile

    - name: Build semantic plugin artifact
      run: mise run //package/oxlint-plugin/prefer-readonly-parameter-type:build:js:node

    - name: Verify native bridge lifecycle and platform paths
      run: mise run //package/oxlint-plugin/prefer-readonly-parameter-type:test:semantic-bridge-host

    - name: Verify external consumer artifact
      run: mise run //package/oxlint-plugin/prefer-readonly-parameter-type:test:external-consumer-host
